title: Open-Source AGI Safety Monitoring Dashboard
description: We propose to build an open-source dashboard that monitors AI agent behavior across multiple DAO governance contexts. The system will track proposal patterns, voting anomalies, and policy drift in real-time, surfacing alerts when governance behavior deviates from established norms. All code will be MIT-licensed and the live dashboard will be publicly accessible.
problem_statement: DAO governance processes lack real-time observability into AI-assisted decision patterns. Stewards cannot easily detect when agent recommendations cluster in ways that may reflect bias or policy drift, creating invisible concentration risk.

deliverables.description: Data ingestion pipeline for GitHub Issues and Snapshot votes
Anomaly detection module using statistical baseline models
React dashboard with alert system and public API
Documentation, deployment guide, and demo video

team.name: Dr. Alex Chen
team.relevant_experience: 5 years building governance tooling for DeSci communities

team.name: Maria Santos
team.relevant_experience: ML researcher, 3 published papers on algorithmic fairness

beneficiaries: All DAOs using AI-assisted governance tooling; estimated 200+ orgs in the public-goods ecosystem
open_source_plan: All code under MIT license. Monthly dev logs published on GitHub. Final dataset made available under CC-BY-4.0 within 90 days of project completion.
risk_assessment: Primary risk is adoption friction; mitigated by designing for easy integration. No personal data collected. No irreversible operations.
